annotations.title: French creditor objection deadline lookup (BODACC, by SIREN)

description: Use this when you need to know whether a French company that owes you money is selling its business, merging or demerging, and until what date its creditors can object. For 1 to 50 SIREN: business sales (fonds de commerce), mergers, demergers and partial asset transfers published in the BODACC in the last 12 months, the last day to object (10 days for a business sale, art. L141-14 Code de commerce; 30 days for a merger, art. R236-11), days left and where to serve the objection. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.

sirens.description: 1 to 50 SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits) of the debtors, comma-separated

name: oppositions_lookup

annulations_verifiees.description: False when the search for cancellation and correction notices timed out: check the deadlines on the notice

annule_par.description: Cancellation notice: this notice is void and opens no window

date_au_plus_tot.description: Mergers: a later insertion may push the date back

delai_compte_depuis.description: Correction whose original notice is missing: deadline counted from the original publication

domicile_opposition.description: Where to serve the objection (business sales)

ouvre_un_delai_d_opposition.description: True when the company's creditors may object

phrase_de_l_avis.description: Deadline sentence quoted from the notice (French)
